access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-14 (T-3553) from the museum's open-access image and object record: a cream silk ensemble by S. Gluck: a long coat with frogged braid fastenings and scrolls of braid embroidery, dark collar and cuffs, over a matching skirt worked with braid scrolls. A real garment, American, not of Chicago and not of anyone drawn in the town.
note: One of the T-3553 finery references (docs/RESEARCH/finery-3553/README.md): the braided suit.
